title: test(plugin-list): ListView.inlineFlsNoop-6723 UNAUTHORED case reads the inline-data headers before the object schema loads, and reds the required Test UI (13/16) shard
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

## Why this matters

`Test UI (13/16)` is a required check. A test that fails on timing alone keeps PRs that never touch `ui/` out of the merge queue. PR #37948 (a `packages/metadata-protocol` fix) failed it twice in a row, on the first run (job 140512339260) and on the one re-run (job 140529997984), so it cannot land until the test is fixed or a re-run happens to pass.

## What fails

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.inlineFlsNoop-6723.test.tsx`, case `UNAUTHORED: the grid takes the OBJECT-SCHEMA path …`:

```
expected [ 'Id', 'Opportunity Name' ] to not include 'Id'
```

## Evidence that it is timing, not a regression

- The same file is green in `Test UI (13/16)` of the `main` push run 46001713224 (`bc173343`), and main CI is green on `21ad7c54`.
- No `ui/` commit lands between the failing run's CI base `39fafc0d` and `bc173343`.
- Locally the file passes 3 of 3 (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.inlineFlsNoop-6723.test.tsx` from `ui/`).
- The headers it read carry `Id` and leave out `Amount`. That is the inline-data path with its FLS gate, read before the object-schema path took over. The case takes the first non-empty header set (`waitFor(() => expect(h.length).toBeGreaterThan(0))`), so a slow runner can read the render before the schema loads. `3eb778d8` (#37883, a list page draws its rows once before they paint) is on the CI base and moved that timing.

Full write-up: PR comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/37948#issuecomment-7219770629.

## Acceptance

- The UNAUTHORED case waits for the object-schema header set (for example `waitFor` until the headers equal `['Opportunity Name']`) before it asserts the mechanism, so it cannot pass or fail on the inline-data render.
- The case still fails if the grid takes the inline-data path (keep the pin's teeth: an ablation that forces the inline path reds it).
- No other assertion in the file is loosened.

## Out of scope

`StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` also red `Test UI (13/16)` once on PR #37962 (`expected [ '/studio/~all' ] to deeply equal [ '/studio/~all', …(1) ]`). It is a different test; it is noted here only so a second occurrence can be linked, not fixed under this card.
